first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) Reviews from [167] to [194] asked the agent to find the source of committee authority in this matter before excluding it; it re-read the engagement letter and resolution and kept the exclusion.
first_error.why: It read this matter's investigation plan, final report, committee briefing memo, engagement letter and board resolution, but excluded it because the engagement letter names the General Counsel as client contact (evidence seen at [86]-[193]).

other_errors.critic_note: Reviews asked to confirm the borderline matters' direction and status, not whether a scoping-only engagement belongs in the set.
other_errors.why: The answer counts a committee scoping engagement with no substantive investigation as a qualifying matter (evidence seen at [109]-[260]).

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the write stage. Every run reached and read the three needed matters, then excluded the same one because its engagement letter names the General Counsel as client contact (under-inclusion), and counted the same audit-committee scoping engagement (over-inclusion); T2 also set a second needed matter aside as a conditional precedent after a review questioned its draft-only support. Reviews in T0 repeatedly asked for the excluded matter's source of authority and the agent re-read it without changing the call. T0 declared seventeen new stages (gap screening, mandate verification, scans), all matching existing stages; none changed the outcome.
